correctness.rationale: Exact finite 4-vertex table and conditional identities \(\mathbb E[B_S\mid T[U]]=1/4+I_U/2\), \(\mathbb E[A_S\mid T[U]]=I_U+3/4\) establish \(\mathbb E[Z_S\mid T[U]]=0\). Conditional independence over shared-edge information proves pairwise orthogonality and orthogonality to each triangle indicator for all \(n\ge4\). Summing over 4-subsets produces \(Y_n-\mathbb EY_n=(n-3)(X_n-\mathbb EX_n)/2+R_n\). Direct moment calculation yields \(\operatorname{Var}(R_n)=3\binom{n}{4}/64\), \(\operatorname{Var}(X_n)=3\binom{n}{3}/16\), \(\operatorname{Cov}(X_n,Y_n)=3\binom{n}{4}/8\) and \(\operatorname{Corr}(X_n,Y_n)=\sqrt{4(n-3)/(4n-11)}\). All boundaries \(n\ge4\) covered. Exhaustive exact enumeration of orders 4, 5 and 6 and algebraic checks all integer orders through 100 corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Three-/four-cycle counts are canonical first nontrivial tournament motifs, and their joint fluctuation is not determined by previously recorded marginal variances. The theorem provides a complete finite-size least-squares projection, universally orthogonal local residuals, exactly quantified explained variance and the rate at which correlation tends to one. Its local conditional-independence mechanism is transferable to the study of jointly fluctuating motif counts and is not merely a numerical special case.
